name: azulito
description: Monorepo: apps/web (Next.js, frontend) + apps/api (Express, backend) para o app pessoal de controle financeiro integrado ao Nubank via Pluggy.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
